# Yoga walks into a yoga, meditation & holistic wellness firm

The yoga, meditation & holistic wellness world does not cite Yoga in its documentation. It does not need to — it performs the archetype daily, unbilled.

## Before the Office, the Story

**The Chariot Simile.** The body the chariot, the senses the horses, the mind the reins, the intellect the driver, the rider the self: the Kaṭha Upaniṣad’s simile is the oldest complete map of the psychophysical discipline.  Who holds the reins attains the end of the road — ‘the still place from which the wise do not return’.

**The Yoga of Three Paths.** The Gītā democratizes the discipline: jñāna-yoga of knowledge for the philosopher, karma-yoga of selfless work for the householder, bhakti-yoga of devotion for the lover of god.  ‘Yogasthaḥ kuru karmāṇi’ — established in yoga, act — is the verse on which Gandhi claimed to have fed his whole life.

## The Reveal, Seat by Seat

### Yoga, Meditation & Holistic Wellness

Now read the why-line with the office in mind: *The discipline itself — union as practice, the eight limbs as curriculum.* The people doing this work did not borrow the archetype. They re-derived it — the way Yoga was always going to be re-derived wherever union, discipline matters.

### Mental Health & Emotional Wellness

*The stilling of the waves — citta-vṛtti-nirodha as the mind's original therapy.* Nobody in that trade worships at this temple. They just keep its hours.

### Sleep & Recovery Technology

*The disciplines of withdrawal and rest — pratyāhāra as the original sleep-hygiene.* Nobody in that trade worships at this temple. They just keep its hours.

## Not the First Rebrand

Buddhism and Jainism adopted yoga wholesale — the Buddha’s dhyāna is Patañjali’s dhāraṇā by another name — while Sufi India found its own correspondences.  The modern export reversed the flow: haṭha-yoga, stripped of metaphysics, returned to India from the West as physical culture before being re-spiritualized. The office is only the latest translation.
